acceptanceCriteria: Neither file opens / for reading, and both packages declare bounded read scopes.
testrunner is removed from the unbounded-readers list with unbounded-readers-check passing.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1526 (testscopes-1021w, V1-2293/V1-0883). After V1-0883, interop/cem01-go/cem.go:3467 and internal/upgradechanges/refs_unix.go:16 still open / for reading, and testrunner stays on the unbounded-readers list although V1-0624 fixed its read. Expected: neither opens / and testrunner is off the list. Actual: all three remain listed.
title: Remaining opens of / (cem01-go cem.go:3467, upgradechanges refs_unix.go:16) and a stale testrunner entry keep packages on the unbounded-readers list
